scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how the side effects include impaired attention and memory. These side effects have made it difficult for her at her desk job. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I yell at my aunt until she takes the medication, my aunt will continue to live as is. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a severe headache.
outcomes: My aunt experiences a severe headache.
My aunt avoids being yelled at by me.
